exchanges.speaker: Pilot
exchanges.text: Hong Kong Tower, Cathay two five one, two mile final, Runway zero sev-en left.
exchanges.meaning: Reports two miles out on final for Runway 07L.

exchanges.speaker: ATC
exchanges.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Tower, cancel landing clearance, go around immediately, preceding aircraft disabled on runway!
exchanges.meaning: Cancels the landing clearance and orders an immediate go-around because a preceding aircraft is disabled on the runway.

exchanges.speaker: Pilot
exchanges.text: Cancel landing clearance, going around immediately, Cathay two five one.
exchanges.meaning: Readback of the cancelled landing clearance and the immediate go-around.

exchanges.speaker: ATC
exchanges.text: Cathay two five one, fly missed approach, straight ahead climbing fow-er thousand feet, contact Departure wun two tree day-see-mal eight.
exchanges.meaning: Instructs Cathay 251 to fly the missed approach straight ahead to 4,000 feet and contact Departure on 123.8.

exchanges.speaker: Pilot
exchanges.text: Straight ahead climbing fow-er thousand feet, Departure wun two tree day-see-mal eight, Cathay two five one.
exchanges.meaning: Readback of the missed approach climb and the Departure frequency.

exchanges.speaker: Pilot
exchanges.text: Hong Kong Departure, Cathay two five one, passing two thousand feet climbing fow-er thousand feet, going around Runway zero sev-en left.
exchanges.meaning: Checks in with Departure passing 2,000 feet climbing to 4,000 feet after going around from Runway 07L.

exchanges.speaker: ATC
exchanges.text: Cathay two five one, Hong Kong Departure, radar contact, climb five thousand feet, report intentions.
exchanges.meaning: Confirms radar contact, clears Cathay 251 to 5,000 feet, and asks for its intentions.

exchanges.speaker: Pilot
exchanges.text: Climb five thousand feet, request radar vectors for another ILS Runway zero sev-en left, Cathay two five one.
exchanges.meaning: Readback of the climb to 5,000 feet and request for radar vectors for another ILS approach to Runway 07L.

vocabulary.definition: Standard pilot transmission initiating missed approach.
Command to track published missed approach routing.
Go-around initiated from low altitude (below 50 ft / flare). Engines at idle take seconds to spool up.
Point where missed approach must be initiated if no visual contact. Decision point on instrument charts.

quiz.question: What is the initial flight deck action required upon deciding to execute a missed approach on an instrument approach procedure?
options: Apply maximum go-around thrust, pitch up to arrest descent and establish a positive climb rate, and configure flaps/landing gear.
Retract all flaps fully before adding engine power.
Turn 90 degrees away from the localizer.
quiz.explanation: A go-around requires simultaneous application of maximum go-around thrust, pitching up to arrest sink rate, and retracting drag devices (flaps by one stage, landing gear upon positive climb).

quiz.question: What is the standard minimum climb gradient required by ICAO PANS-OPS for a missed approach procedure unless a higher gradient is specifically published on the approach chart?
quiz.explanation: Under ICAO PANS-OPS (Doc 8168), the nominal design climb gradient for a missed approach is 2.5% (approx. 152 ft/NM) unless a steeper gradient is specified for obstacle clearance.

sections.heading: Section 2: Core Learning Content & Vocabulary Table
sections.body: Going around — Standard pilot transmission initiating missed approach. "Cathay 251, going around." / Cancel landing clearance — ATC instruction revoking landing authorization. Immediate abort ordered by Tower! / Fly missed approach — Command to track published missed approach routing. Climb straight ahead or track fix. / Balked landing — Go-around initiated from low altitude (below 50 ft / flare). Engines at idle take seconds to spool up! / Missed Approach Point (MAPt) — Point where missed approach must be initiated if no visual contact. Decision point on instrument charts.

sections.heading: Section 8: Spaced Repetition Review Drill
sections.body: Day 38 Review (+1d): In touch-and-go operations, remaining runway must always exceed landing ground roll plus takeoff distance over 50-ft obstacle. Day 36 Review (+3d): Under the ICAO Approach Ban rule, if reported RVR is below minimums before 1,000 ft AGL, the approach cannot legally be continued. Day 32 Review (+7d): Always intercept an ILS glide path from below to avoid capturing false 6 degrees and 9 degrees ground reflection lobes.

sections.heading: Section 9: Fun Aviation Fact — "Plan Continuation Bias"
sections.body: Why do flight crews occasionally attempt dangerous, unstabilized landings? Aviation psychologists call this "Plan Continuation Bias" — the deep human subconscious desire to complete a task once committed. Major airlines now train crews under a core safety philosophy: "A landing is just a go-around that happened not to occur!" Pilots are praised for deciding to go around, with zero disciplinary or financial penalties!
